Commentary.Commentary: The players are out in the middle followed by the umpires for the run chase. Joshua Little will bowl the first over. Kashyap Prajapati and Jatinder Singh are the two openers for Oman.
...RUN CHASE...

Right then, Ireland have 281 on the board and they will be hoping to defend this one. For Oman, the onus is on their batters to bat well and chase this down. Which side will get over the line? Let's find out together. Chase coming up shortly...

Harry Tector is in for a quick chat. He says that it is a good total. Adds that the pitch was not good to bat on and he is feeling good to score a fifty. Says that it is their first game and George was fantastic. Ends by saying that his advice to the bowlers is that to bowl on the wickets.

Oman will be slightly upset with their effort later on in the game. After starting well, they lost momentum in the middle and failed to pick the wicket of George Dockrell who scored an unbeaten 91 runs. Fayyaz Butt and Bilal Khan picked up two wickets each whilst Zeeshan Maqsood, Ayaan Khan and Jay Odedra chipped in with a wicket each.

Well, that was a fine inning from George Dockrell. Just when his team needed him the most, he performed well with the bat and made his side reach a good total of 281 runs! Ireland started off well, but when they lost Paul Stirling, wickets kept on tumbling for them. Harry Tector and George Dockrell then stitched a good 79-run partnership for the 5th wicket but Harry Tector was dismissed after scoring a half-century. George Dockrell carried on with the good work and led his side reach a total of 281 runs.
SIX! George Dockrell ends with a bang! Full and on off, George Dockrell picks it well and heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum! Ireland ends their innings for 281/7.

Commentary.Commentary: The pre-match formalities are done and we are all set for live action. Andy McBrine and Paul Stirling are the two openers for Ireland. While Bilal Khan will bowl the first over.
The Umpires are out in the middle followed by the players from both sides for their respective National Anthems.
Oman (Playing XI) - Zeeshan Maqsood (C), Jatinder Singh, Kashyap Prajapati, Mohammad Nadeem, Shoaib Khan, Bilal Khan, Jay Odedra, Ayaan Khan, Fayyaz Butt, Naseem Khushi (WK), Aqib Ilyas
Ireland (Playing XI) - Mark Adair, Andy Balbirnie (C), Gareth Delany, George Dockrell, Graham Hume, Joshua Little, Andy McBrine, Paul Stirling, Harry Tector, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Benjamin White.
TOSS-: Oman has won the toss and they have decided to bowl first.

Oman, on the other hand, had lost in the semi-finals of the ACC Premier League against UAE in a close contest. The side will be high on confidence and will look to start their campaign with a win in this game. Which side will come out on top? Let's find out. Toss and team news to follow shortly...

Hello and a warm welcome to match number 4 as Ireland takes on Oman. Ireland had lost an ODI series by 2-0 earlier this year against Bangladesh. Andy Balbirnie will look to leave that behind and bring their A-game forward.
...MATCH DAY...

ICC Cricket World Cup Qualifiers have begun and we have Ireland taking on Oman in Match no. 4 at Bulawayo Athletic Club, Bulawayo to gain early ground in Group B. Zimbabwe is hosting the 10-team Qualification event where the sides will be fighting for the final 2 spots up for grabs for participation in the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup later in the year in India. Ireland has a solid side and is undoubtedly a team to watch out for as they have a perfect mix of youth and experience at their exposure. Andy Balbirnie will be leading the Irish side filled with explosive players like Paul Stirling, George Dockrell, Joshua Little etc... Ireland has been batting well recently but a lot would depend on the bowlers if they are to advance through to the next stage. Oman has been on an upward graph recently and is improving at a serious rate. They have a good enough side to give a fight to any opponent on any given day. Oman did well in the recently commenced Asian Qualifiers as well where they reached the final. Oman is heavily dependent on their top order to come good and give the team a solid start as the only area of concern for them being an Associate nation at this point is finishing off the games. Zeeshan Maqsood will be leading the pack hoping that they could set the right tone for themselves by defeating Ireland. Expect a thrilling contest between these two well-balanced sides.
